title: The Almost Scholarship
author: Lena Eastwick
blurb: Odile Brightwater, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
